assets.name: rex-encounter-wide
assets.prompt: Original Primal Echo promotional BOSS ENCOUNTER scene in authentic detailed PIXEL ART, not an isolated sprite. Reference1 supplies ONLY dramatic composition: tiny rear-facing Kael confronting a colossal Rex amid overgrown technological ruins and cyan mist. Replace that fossil/stone monster COMPLETELY with reference2's mechanical Rex design: narrow long manufactured dinosaur head, ivory angular armor plates on black mechanical skeleton, orange cables, orange triangular shoulder marking, large black rectangular dorsal power module with cyan square light grid, thin arcing antenna cables above back, segmented tapering tail, small forearms, strong digitigrade hind legs and metal claws. NO rock armor, no fossil skull, no organic bone spikes, no moss on Rex. Preserve this design faithfully while adapting perspective to an imposing three-quarter confrontation. Reference3 defines Kael: messy chestnut hair, orange shirt, backpack, cyan bracelet, spear and bow. Kael is small in foreground facing Rex, not posing toward viewer. Vast ruined technological facility reclaimed by jungle, cyan light shafts, navy blue layered fog rendered with dithering, rich spatial depth, dangerous mood. Strong deliberate square pixel clusters and stepped edges, no smooth painting, no blur, no 3D. No text, logos or other characters. Keep Rex's entire silhouette (tail, antennae, head and both feet) inside the composition with safe margin. Widescreen horizontal16:9. Rex dominates center and right, tiny Kael at bottom center-right; darker left quarter for website text. Do not crop the dinosaur.
